name: @greenhouse-resume-builder/cap-engagements-ui
description: M6 — chat UI that is a real MCP-Apps host over the M5 orchestrator. Chat + persona selector call POST :3020/ask (one-shot) or the interactive area-first planner (:3020/plan-options + /build); when a tripMap is returned it is rendered as the sandboxed ui://trip-map MCP App (double-iframe isolation via the ext-apps AppBridge).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && concurrently "cross-env INPUT=index.html vite build" "cross-env INPUT=sandbox.html vite build"
scripts.watch: concurrently "cross-env INPUT=index.html vite build --watch" "cross-env INPUT=sandbox.html vite build --watch"
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.demo: npm run build && concurrently -k -n mcp,orchestrator,chat -c green,cyan,magenta "cross-env ENGAGEMENTS_MCP_PORT=3010 npm run serve -w @greenhouse-resume-builder/cap-engagements-mcp-engagements" "npm run serve -w @greenhouse-resume-builder/cap-engagements-agent" "npm run serve"
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run watch" "tsx watch serve.ts"
